title: Spotless Gem | Hot Tub | 15 Min to Broadway
description:
Guest favorite with hundreds of 5-star reviews! Guests LOVE our spotlessly clean home, unbeatable location (15 min to downtown but peacefully quiet), & responsive hosting. This stylish 3-bed/3-bath is perfect for groups—each bedroom has its own bathroom. Relax in the hot tub, play arcade games, spin vintage vinyl, sleep on memory foam beds guests rave about. Fully-stocked kitchen, baby gear available, private backyard oasis. Every detail thoughtfully planned for an unforgettable Nashville stay!

The space
Our charming home is one side of a a new duplex build in one of Nashville’s fasting growing neighborhoods, Woodbine! With some of the best local coffee shops (Red Bicycle, Sam & Zoe’s, District, and Tempo - to name a few!) and restaurants , you’ll love the convenience to downtown, but the quiet of the neighborhood. The design of the home features shiplap walls, floral wallpaper, a bright, airy kitchen, and outdoor living space that looks out over tons of green grass and trees with a spacious backyard. 

*Please note there is construction in the lot to the right (facing the property) of the house

★☆DOWNSTAIRS★☆
-One bedroom w/Queen bed with a full bathroom
-Open concept kitchen, 50inch TV, and dining room - dining table with seating for 6. Kitchen counter seating for 4. 
-Kitchen fully equipped with cookware, dish ware, drip coffee maker, Keurig Mini, and mini french press with some coffee beans and a grinder to get your started.

★☆UPSTAIRS★☆
-Living room with a Queen size sleeper sofa.
-2 bedrooms - One with a King bed, the other with a Queen. 
-2 bathrooms - One master suite with huge bathroom with double sinks en suite to the King bed bedroom, and another full bathroom next to the 2nd bedroom with the Queen bed. 
-Comfortable and stylish living room to hang out in and watch TV on a large screen Smart TV. Netflix, Hulu and other apps can be accessed with own login.
-Washer & Dryer available for guest use. 

OUTDOORS
-Hot tub and fire pit. 
-Grill w/propane tank. 
-Fire Pit - will need to purchase your own wood. 

**PLEASE NOTE: Please remove any snow/ice/debris from the cover of the hot tub before attempting to open! Failure will do so may result in damages.

BABY GEAR
-Pack and Play (Sheets and bedding are not provided)
-High Chair 
Please note: exterior cameras are used for safety and property protection.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire house with the exception of any locked owner's closets and the attic.

Other things to note
*Please note there is construction in the lot to the right (facing the property) of the house
